bibl.title: Avoiding the Judge: the Exclusion of the δίκη in Contractual Clauses.
bibl.seg: José-Domingo Rodríguez Martín, Avoiding the Judge: the Exclusion of the δίκη in Contractual Clauses.

Alberto Nodar & Sofía Torallas Tovar (edd.), coedited by María Jesús Albarrán Martínez, Raquel Martín Hernández, Irene Pajón Leyra, José Domingo Rodríguez Martín & Marco Antonio Santamaría, Proceedings of the 28th Congress of Papyrology (Barcelona August 1st-6th, 2016) = Scripta Orientalia. 3 (Barcelona, 2019) pp. 484-493.
bibl.note: 1. Textual Variations of the καθάπερ ἐκ δίκης Formula? - 2. Case study: a. Καθάπερ δίκην ὠφληκότων; - b. Ὡς ἐκ / ἀπὸ / λογῳ καταδίκης; - c. Ἐνεχυράζειν πρὸ δίκης; - d. Καθάπερ καὶ τῶν ἄλλων τῶν δημοσίων δικῶν; - e. ῎Ανευ δίκης καὶ κρίσεως. - 3. Conclusions.
